Knto Cinco in Lapu-Lapu exceeded my expectations. The ambiance is cozy, well-designed, and very relaxing. We tried the Pasta El Cinco and it was super yummy. Their matcha and Spanish latte are top tier, and the pizzadilla is a must-try. The service was excellent, with friendly and attentive staff, and the huge parking space made the visit very convenient. Definitely coming back and highly recommending this place.
